kjv_ot_histories.setting: the ancient Near East (Mesopotamia, Canaan, Egypt), from the patriarchs (as the text dates them, early in the second millennium BC) to the fall of Jerusalem in 586 BC

josephus_antiquities_1_11.setting: the ancient Near East, from the creation and the patriarchs to Alexander the Great (about 330 BC), as Josephus tells the history of the Jews

pope_iliad.setting: Troy and the Greek camp before it, in the Late Bronze Age Aegean (the Trojan War, about 1250-1180 BC, as the poem tells it)

pope_odyssey.setting: the Aegean and Mediterranean world just after the Trojan War, in the Late Bronze Age (about 1200-1170 BC, as the poem tells it)

herodotus_beloe_1791.setting: the Greek and Persian world (Greece, Asia Minor, Persia, Egypt, Scythia, Libya) from legendary times to the Persian Wars of 490-479 BC

koran_sale.setting: Arabia in the lifetime of Muhammad (about AD 610-632); its stories of earlier prophets are set in the ancient Near East at their own times

mesoamerican_native.setting: Mesoamerica (the Maya highlands and lowlands, central Mexico) before the Spanish conquest, and the conquest years (to about AD 1560) where a text reaches them

ossian_macpherson.setting: Scotland, Ireland and Scandinavia in the third century AD (the age of Fingal, as the poems claim)

chronicles_of_eri.setting: ancient Scythia, Iberia and Ireland, about 1000 BC (as the book claims)

spalding_manuscript.setting: eastern North America in the time of the Roman emperor Constantine (4th century AD), as the manuscript claims

late_war.setting: the United States and Britain during the War of 1812 (1812-1815)

book_of_mormon.setting: Mesoamerica, about 600 BC to AD 421 (the book's main narrative; the Jaredite record in Ether begins much earlier)
